metadata.summary: "We couldn't find a way to get ourselves into the game. With the ball, without the ball, we were off it." A fair assessment from Michael Carrick, if not a wholly explanatory one.
metadata.content: Man Utd 1-1 Spurs: Michael Carrick entering a defining period and must correct underperformance quickly | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Opinion Man Utd 1-1 Spurs: Michael Carrick entering a defining period and must correct underperformance quickly Tottenham snatched a 1-1 draw with 10 men at Manchester United on Saturday, calling Michael Carrick's decision-making further into question; the Man Utd boss has failed to offer many answers to his side's underperformance so far this season; a defining period comes next Sunday 11 October 2026 08:09, UK Image: Bruno Fernandes looks perplexed as Man Utd blow their lead over Spurs in stoppage time "We couldn't find a way to get ourselves into the game. With the ball, without the ball, we were off it." A fair assessment from Michael Carrick, if not a wholly explanatory one. Stuck in the mire of Manchester United's worst start to a league season for 40 years, the manager appeared lost for legitimate reasons. His margin for error is shrinking by the week. Why were his side outplayed at home by the Premier League's bottom club? Why can't they hold onto leads? Why do they seem incapable of playing against 10 men? Image: Michael Carrick looks on during Man Utd's draw with Tottenham All of these are fair questions to put to the man himself and many were asked of Carrick in the wake of Saturday's 1-1 draw with Spurs. messages.text: Sherrock, Hayter qualify for Worlds as Greaves sweeps up on Women's Series

metadata.summary: Fallon Sherrock and Gemma Hayter have qualified for the 2027 PDC World Championship as Beau Greaves won Events 21-22 at the Women's Series in Wigan on Saturday.
metadata.content: PDC Women's Series: Fallon Sherrock and Gemma Hayter qualify for World Championship as Beau Greaves sweeps up with Events 21-22 in Wigan | Darts News | Sky Sports Skip to main content PDC Women's Series: Fallon Sherrock and Gemma Hayter qualify for World Championship as Beau Greaves sweeps up with Events 21-22 in Wigan Beau Greaves continues her monopoly of the PDC Women's Series, defeating Vicky Pruim in the Event 21 decider and Gemma Hayter 5-3 to claim the Event 22 title; you can watch the Grand Slam of Darts in Wolverhampton live on Sky Sports from November 14-22 Saturday 10 October 2026 20:36, UK Image: Fallon Sherrock will return to Alexandra Palace, where she wrote history in 2020 Fallon Sherrock and Gemma Hayter have qualified for the 2027 PDC World Championship as Beau Greaves won Events 21-22 at the Women's Series in Wigan on Saturday. 'The Queen of the Palace' will return to the place where she wrote history in 2020, after she confirmed her spot in the top five of the Women's Series. Sherrock became the first (and only) woman to pick up wins at Alexandra Palace, beating Ted Evetts and Mensur Suljovic before losing to Chris Dobey.
